title: ManifestAsset
description: Named model asset such as config, tokenizer or chat template.

blob.description: Stored asset bytes; the directory must also declare the same asset name.

name.description: Safe basename, not an extraction path.

BlobId.description: Content identity for stored tensor or asset bytes.

BlobReference.description: Stored-byte blob reference, local unless a declared shard is selected.

id.description: BLAKE3 of the exact stored blob bytes, not a semantic tensor digest.

shard.description: Basename of a declared shard; `None` selects the root package.
